summary: Converts an 80-bit extended float argument into a fixed-width decimal string and packs the result into a caller-provided _DWORD output record a3. Unpacks the float with Float80ToFloat64Unpack into a two-dword pair, formats it through sub_5976E8 with a trailing-word parameter, length limit 17 and a null precision parameter into the character buffer v9, then writes the format length to a3[2], a first character to a3[0], the buffer value to a3[1], and the forwarded a4 value to a3[3]. Calls sub_58FCA0 before writing a3[3] and returns a3.

operations.description: Call Float80ToFloat64Unpack(v11, &a1) to unpack the 80-bit extended float argument a1 into the two-dword pair v11.
Copy the trailing stack word v12 into v8 (a value carried through to the formatter call).

Call sub_5976E8(v11[0], v11[1], v8, 17, 0, &v9): formats the unpacked float value using the trailing word v8, a width/limit of 17 and a null precision argument, writing the resulting character data into the buffer v9 and returning a length in v4.
Store the formatter return value as the output record length: a3[2] = v4.
Store a first character from the stack into the output record: a3[0] = v10.
Store the formatted character buffer value into the output record: a3[1] = v9.
Call sub_58FCA0() with no arguments before the final output field is written.
Forward the caller argument into the output record: a3[3] = a4.
Return the output record pointer a3.
